newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka rupee slips on import covering by close.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka rupee slips on import covering by close.

text.p: The Sri Lanka rupee closed soft on import covering and speculation that there may be increased demand for dollars next week, dealers said.
The rupee closed at 56.94 to the dollar after opening at 56.83.
"The rupee closed down due to import covering by a state bank, and market perception that next week could see a private bank in the market for dollars," said a Standrad Chartered Bank dealer.
Overnight call money closed at 13.5 percent after opening at 15.
